item.title: Home for the Holidays - SPCA International
item.description: Thanks to our Patriot Pets program and the incredible generosity of supporters like you, we have been able to reunite a remarkable number of dogs and cats with the U.S. service members who befriended them overseas during deployment. We have watched brave soldiers and their beloved animals run into each other’s arms, share long-awaited snuggles, and finally relax in the comfort of being together again.

item.title: Smiles, Snuggles & Second Chances - SPCA International
item.description: Remember Rani, Ari, and Gerry, the dogs who needed urgent help earlier this year? Thanks to you, their stories now have happy endings! Check out their inspiring before-and-after photos and how your support made it all possible!

item.title: Taking a Stand for Spanish Greyhounds - SPCA International
item.description: We’re packing our bags and heading to Spain with one clear mission: to help save Galgos. For nearly a decade, we’ve worked alongside our trusted partner, SOS Galgos, to rescue Galgos, also known as Spanish Greyhounds, from abuse, neglect, and death. While some progress has been made, there is still much work to be done. That’s why we’re returning to Spain to speak up for these innocent dogs, push for real change at the government level, and continue rescuing Galgos who desperately need help.

item.title: Home, Against All Odds - SPCA International
item.description: Last month, you helped make a beautiful reunion possible. While deployed overseas, Angel, a U.S. service member, rescued a sweet stray cat named Nala and dreamed of giving her the safe, happy life she deserved. Bringing Nala to the United States wasn’t easy, but thanks to your generosity, we were able to bring her into our care and fly her safely home. item.title: A New Beginning - SPCA International
item.description: Last month, we shared an urgent plea to save Camino, a Spanish Greyhound found clinging to life. You responded immediately, and together, we gave her a second chance. Thank you for making hope possible.

item.title: Taking Action This Spay & Neuter Month - SPCA International
item.description: Spaying and neutering is one of the most humane ways to prevent suffering, keep communities safe, and give pets healthier lives. That’s why we’re working to make sterilization surgeries more accessible than ever.

item.title: SPCA International Goes to Spain: Hope for Galgos - SPCA International
item.description: Earlier this month, our team traveled to Spain to advocate for Galgos, Spanish Greyhounds who have been quietly suffering for far too long. Alongside our trusted local partner, SOS GALGOS, we met with local leaders, joined passionate advocates, visited places where help is urgently needed, and witnessed the resilience of the Galgos we all care so deeply about.

item.title: 40 Years Later: Caring for the Dogs of Chornobyl
item.description: We're continuing our commitment to the animals in Ukraine in a powerful new way by funding an upcoming spay-and-neuter clinic in Chornobyl. This clinic will provide critical care to hundreds of vulnerable animals, helping prevent suffering before it starts and strengthening the future for dogs in the region. The post 40 Years Later: Caring for the Dogs of Chornobyl appeared first on SPCA International.

item.title: See the Difference You Made: 15 Galgos Today! - SPCA International
item.description: Your donations truly save lives, and we want you to see the difference you make. Because of your support, we were recently able to rescue 15 Spanish Greyhounds from neglect and abuse and bring them safely to the United States. Today, we’re thrilled to share that these sweet dogs are happier than ever, and it’s all thanks to you.

item.title: Operation 1M: From Short Chains to Lasting Change - SPCA International
item.description: We are honored to call Korean K9 Rescue one of our shelter partners. Their dedicated team works tirelessly to save dogs across Korea, including those rescued from the dog meat trade and the puppy mill industry. Over the years, we have proudly supported their lifesaving rescue efforts, and we are excited to be able to support them once again as they launch Operation 1M, an initiative designed to create meaningful, lasting change for dogs and the communities they live in.
